_comment: Single source of truth for the Raptor Lake (RPL-P/U Iris Xe) -> Tiger Lake spoof used to bring up iGPU graphics acceleration on macOS 26 Tahoe via NootedGreen. Every other artifact (DeviceProperties plist, boot-args, Gate-A probes, docs) derives from this file. See docs/raptor-lake-tahoe.md.

fallback._comment: Ice Lake (Gen11) was shipped by Apple in real Macs, so its kexts are more likely to keep resolving symbols on Tahoe. Worse architectural match to RPL than TGL; use only if the TGL Gate-A blocker count is unfixable. See docs/raptor-lake-tahoe.md.
